notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Urban Enterprise Zones charge half the state rate; Salem County 3.3125%.
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: New Jersey has no local general sales tax; the 6.625% state rate applies almost everywhere.
Not reflected: the reduced 3.3125% rate charged by qualified sellers in Urban Enterprise Zones and in Salem County, and local tourism and luxury taxes in Atlantic City and the Wildwoods.
